name: Raito Kogyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Raito Kogyo Co., Ltd. engages in the civil engineering works business in Japan, North America, and internationally. It operates through Construction Business and Other segments. The company's civil engineering works services include boundary restoration work; burying of sewer pipes using the submerged construction method; slope protection and stabilization; ground improvement; pile and diaphragm wall; sewage main installation; environmental investigation and remediation; repair and reinforcement of structures; and building construction.
